trades_table_conflicting_definitions.detail: shared_lib.persistence.trade_tracker.TradeTracker and analytics_service.AnalyticsService both CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trades with different NOT NULL constraints (TradeTracker: NOT NULL on run_id..entry_confidence and status, plus idx_trades_run). Whichever runs first on a database decides the schema; the inventory uses TradeTracker's.
